controls.label: Save attendance
controls.instructions: Create/update employee/date. Approved or paid payroll month rejects further edits.

controls.label: Mark a full day for several staff
controls.instructions: Expand batch full-day form.

controls.label: Actual attendance date
controls.instructions: Batch date, no future date.

controls.label: Staff name checkboxes
controls.instructions: Choose active staff whose actual full-day attendance was checked.

controls.label: I checked that each selected staff member worked a full day…
controls.instructions: Required confirmation. Batch replaces existing entries for the selected date.

controls.label: Mark selected staff full day
controls.instructions: Save each selected employee independently. Read saved/failed counts; investigate partial failures before payroll.

controls.label: Refresh attendance
controls.instructions: Reload first page for selected employee/month.

controls.label: Edit attendance
controls.instructions: Load an existing day into the entry form. Review status-dependent quantities before saving.

controls.label: Load more attendance
controls.instructions: Append next page of up to 100 day records.

controls.label: Staff member
controls.instructions: Choose employee; no login is required for salary.

controls.label: Salary month
controls.instructions: Closed month only. Request uses the first day of that month.

controls.label: Bonus for this month (Rs)
controls.instructions: Nonnegative monthly bonus in rupees, converted to paise.

controls.label: Extra allowances for this month / Extra deductions for this month
controls.instructions: Use Add item, Item name, Amount (Rs), Remove item component controls. Recurring employee components are included automatically.

controls.label: Preview attendance calculation
controls.instructions: Compute current attendance/policy snapshot; missing scheduled day or unclosed month blocks calculation.

controls.label: Generate / update payroll draft
controls.instructions: Generate from current attendance and current extra fields. Replaces monthly extras on regeneration; approved/paid payroll is locked.

controls.label: Show every attendance day
controls.instructions: Expand date-level paid/LOP units and notes.

controls.label: Refresh payroll runs
controls.instructions: Reload first page.

controls.label: Export loaded payroll CSV
controls.instructions: Export only currently loaded runs and payment references. Load more first if needed.

controls.label: View payslip
controls.instructions: Open saved salary breakdown, components and status.

controls.label: Edit draft extras
controls.instructions: Restore saved monthly bonus, extra allowances and extra deductions to the form. Regenerate to save edits.

controls.label: Approve payroll
controls.instructions: Recompute/hash-check draft against current employee/policy/attendance. Stale draft must be regenerated.

controls.label: Record salary payment
controls.instructions: Open payment form for approved run. Complete payment outside app first.

controls.label: Payment method
controls.instructions: bank, upi, cash or card.

controls.label: Payment reference / cash voucher
controls.instructions: 6–100 characters for actual completed salary payment.

controls.label: I completed and checked the salary payment outside the app
controls.instructions: Required confirmation of real movement.

controls.label: Mark salary paid & log expense
controls.instructions: Record paid state and one payroll-source expense for positive net. This does not initiate a transfer.

controls.label: Cancel payment entry
controls.instructions: Close payment form without posting.

controls.label: Load more payroll runs
controls.instructions: Append next page of up to 100 runs.

controls.label: Print payslip
controls.instructions: Open system print dialog with current saved payslip.

controls.label: Close payslip
controls.instructions: Close payslip preview.

controls.label: Product
controls.instructions: All products or one product.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Purchase ID (optional)
controls.instructions: Optional valid purchase UUID; opened prefilled from purchase details.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Stickers in this batch (maximum 500)
controls.instructions: Load 1–500 unique in-stock unit identities. This is a number of distinct pieces, not copies per barcode.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Paper
controls.instructions: A4 sticker sheet (2 columns) or Single-label roll.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Sticker width (mm, 80–95)
controls.instructions: Match supported label stock; paper choice initializes width.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Sticker height (mm, 30–60)
controls.instructions: Match physical label height.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Load stock labels
controls.instructions: Load first matching batch. Reprinting never adds stock.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Print labels
controls.instructions: Record print request for loaded identities, then open browser print dialog. App cannot confirm physical printing.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Refresh this label batch
controls.instructions: Reload current cursor batch.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: Next label batch
controls.instructions: Replace preview with next set of distinct units.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: First label batch
controls.instructions: Return to first batch when cursor is beyond first.
controls.access: Staff MFA + inventory. Enable Code 39 on scanner; test one label at 100% scale with quiet margins.

controls.label: From / To
controls.instructions: Inclusive India-date range, maximum 366 days.
controls.access: Staff MFA + reports capability; only permitted metric groups are returned

controls.label: Run report
controls.instructions: Fetch summary. POS sales/returns use respective event dates, tenders show gross sale-day receipts, online totals use creation-period orders currently paid, stock and supplier balances are current.
controls.access: Staff MFA + reports capability; only permitted metric groups are returned

controls.label: Export report CSV
controls.instructions: Export the currently displayed summary and gross POS tender receipts.
controls.access: Staff MFA + reports capability; only permitted metric groups are returned
